# open-todoist

> A local-first, keyboard-first open source task manager with natural-language
> quick add. No account, no server, no telemetry.

## What this is

open-todoist is a MIT-licensed task manager for the browser. It is an
independent, unofficial, unaffiliated clean-room reimplementation in the
open-source alternative tradition — it is not a fork or a port of Todoist, and
it contains none of Doist's code, assets or brand material.

Key properties:

- **Local-first.** All data lives in the browser's IndexedDB. The app makes zero
  network requests after load; there is no API client in the codebase.
- **No account.** No sign-up, no login, no email address, no server.
- **Offline task manager.** Works with no connection at all.
- **Privacy-first.** No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party scripts. Runtime
  dependencies are `react` and `react-dom` only.
- **Keyboard-first.** Every action has a shortcut; everything is reachable from
  the ⌘K command palette.
- **Natural-language task manager.** One line of text becomes a dated, timed,
  prioritised, filed task.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
npm run build      # tsc --noEmit && vite build
npm test           # 165 tests
```

Node 18+. No configuration or environment variables required.

## Key facts

- Runtime dependencies: `react`, `react-dom` (2 total)
- ~3,700 lines of TypeScript, 415 lines of CSS, 1,073 lines of tests
- 165 tests in 5 suites, all running in Node with no DOM shim
- Storage: IndexedDB, 3 object stores, with a localStorage fallback
- Data formats: JSON import/export, CSV export (12 columns)
- Two languages in the parser: English and Chinese

## Optional

- [llms-full.md](llms-full.md) — long-form feature and behaviour description

## Non-goals

No accounts, no servers, no sync, no telemetry, no ads, no AI features that
transmit task data. This project will not add them.
